goal.title: Validate v1.0.1 multi-channel installation on macOS and codify release verification lessons
goal.intent: Step-by-step clean-room validation of POSIX installer, Coursier JVM launch, Coursier channel install, and Homebrew upgrade on macOS Apple Silicon, capturing friction and remediation across docs and release skills.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Validate install.sh, cs launch, cs install, and brew upgrade on macOS aarch64
Fix Coursier channel branch syntax (gh:oswaldo/context-crystal/main) across docs and skills
Codify isolated smoke test flags and cross-platform CI verification lessons in multi-channel-release skill

nodes.contentSummary: Initialized crystal 'macos-release-validation' with goal: Validate v1.0.1 multi-channel installation on macOS and codify release verification lessons
Verified v1.0.1 across install.sh, cs launch, cs install (with /main fix), and brew upgrade on macOS aarch64, and cleaned up temporary binaries and dangling Coursier symlink.
Applied doc/skill fixes, added verify-release-smoke CI job, fixed BatchExecutor quote splitting and pre-validation, and verified scalafmt, scalafix, markdownlint, and BatchExecutorSuite.

transientLeases.description: Isolated worktree for macOS v1.0.1 release validation and doc fixes

lessonsLearned.observedFriction: cs install --channel gh:oswaldo/context-crystal:main failed with 404 on https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oswaldo/context-crystal/master/main
lessonsLearned.rootCause: Coursier gh: shorthand treats a colon (:main) as a file path on the default master branch, whereas a slash (/main) specifies the branch name and defaults to apps.json
lessonsLearned.recommendedAction: Replace gh:oswaldo/context-crystal:main with gh:oswaldo/context-crystal/main in README.md, docs/contributing.md, and skills/multi-channel-release/SKILL.md

actionAuditTrail.action: Updated gh:oswaldo/context-crystal:main to gh:oswaldo/context-crystal/main across README.md, docs/contributing.md, and skills/multi-channel-release/SKILL.md

lessonsLearned.observedFriction: Validating a release only from the Linux build machine missed the Coursier channel syntax error and requires manual cross-machine testing on macOS
lessonsLearned.rootCause: Release workflow publishes artifacts and Maven Central packages but lacks an automated post-release smoke-verification matrix testing exact documented install commands on clean Linux and macOS runners
lessonsLearned.recommendedAction: Add automated post-release smoke verification in CI (ubuntu-latest and macos-latest) executing exact README installation pathways so release stability does not depend on which machine or human cuts the release

actionAuditTrail.action: Added verify-release-smoke matrix job (ubuntu-latest and macos-14) in .github/workflows/release.yml and documented in multi-channel-release skill

lessonsLearned.observedFriction: ccrystal --version failed with Unexpected option: --version when verifying which release binary was active across installation channels
lessonsLearned.rootCause: Top-level --version / -v flag (Track 21) is not yet wired into the Decline CLI root parser
lessonsLearned.recommendedAction: Prioritize Track 21 (ccrystal --version / -v) and assert version output in install.sh, Homebrew test block, and CI smoke tests

actionAuditTrail.action: Verified Track 21 (ccrystal --version / -v) is queued in conductor/next-steps.md and documented version assertion target

lessonsLearned.observedFriction: Testing multiple installation methods on a user machine left a dangling symlink in ~/Library/Application Support/Coursier/bin/ccrystal and risked shadowing Homebrew in PATH
lessonsLearned.rootCause: Smoke verification snippets in skills/multi-channel-release/SKILL.md install directly into default global directories (~/.local/bin and Coursier default bin) without isolation flags
lessonsLearned.recommendedAction: Update Clean-Room Smoke Verification in skills/multi-channel-release/SKILL.md to use isolated temporary directories (install.sh --to and cs install --install-dir) with automatic cleanup

actionAuditTrail.action: Updated Clean-Room Smoke Verification in docs/contributing.md and skills/multi-channel-release/SKILL.md to use isolated SMOKE_DIR (--to and --install-dir) with cleanup

lessonsLearned.observedFriction: ccrystal batch failed with a syntax error when a quoted node summary contained a semicolon (;), and executed earlier commands in the batch before rejecting the malformed command
lessonsLearned.rootCause: BatchExecutor.splitCommands calls chain.split(";") without quote awareness before parseCommandLine, and executeChain interleaves CommandParser.parse with runner.run instead of pre-validating all commands in the batch
lessonsLearned.recommendedAction: Make BatchExecutor.splitCommands quote-aware so semicolons inside single or double quotes are preserved, and pre-parse/validate all batch commands before executing mutations

actionAuditTrail.action: Updated BatchExecutor.splitCommands for quote-aware semicolon splitting and BatchExecutor.executeChain for pre-execution command validation with unit tests in BatchExecutorSuite
